mapper.select: select trip_uuid, trip_nm, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, member_cnt, trip_location from trip order by start_date

select trip_nm, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, member_cnt, trip_location, trip_type, trip_memo from trip where trip_uuid = #{uuid}::uuid and delete_yn='N'
mapper.update: update trip set trip_nm = #{trip_nm}, trip_location = #{trip_location}, start_date = #{start_date}::date, end_date = #{end_date}::date, trip_type = #{trip_type}, member_cnt = #{member_cnt}::int, trip_memo = #{trip_memo}, update_at = now() where trip_uuid = #{uuid}::uuid
mapper.select: select name as place_name, category as place_category, place_address, lng as place_lng, lat as place_lat, order_no, memo as place_memo, place_url from place where delete_yn = 'N' and trip_id = #{trip_id} order by order_no asc
select count(*) from place where trip_uuid = #{uuid}::uuid
select trip_id from trip where trip_uuid = #{uuid}::uuid
select p.name, p.category, p.lag, p.lng, p.order_no, p.visit_date, p.memo from trip t inner join place p on t.trip_id = p.trip_id where t.trip_uuid = #{uuid}

insert.foreach: insert into place ( trip_id, name, category, lat, lng, order_no, memo, place_address, place_url ) values ( #{place.trip_id} , #{place.place_name}, #{place.category_name}, #{place.place_lat}, #{place.place_lng}, #{place.order_no}::int, #{place.place_memo}, #{place.place_address}, #{place.place_url} )
